Merged SOP steps:
- Set call routing priority: first to Client User, second blank, third to Voice AI Agent.
- Set incoming call timeout to 7-10 seconds and outgoing call timeout to 20 seconds.
- Set user forwarding settings to Web App & Mobile App.

- Set the call recording text to exactly: Calls are recorded for quality purposes.
- Turn on Missed Call Text Back and customize the greeting message.

Merged SOP steps:
- Crawl the client's website to generate the AI Knowledgebase.
- Configure the Voice AI prompt to ask qualifying questions and offer a human callback instead of booking appointments.
- Mark Configure AI Answering Service complete in LaunchBay.

<details><summary>Guidance for the team (3 tasks)</summary>

**`rsp-050` Configure wallet auto-recharge ($100 / $10 threshold)**

Merged SOP steps:
- Navigate to the client's GHL sub-account settings and open Billing.
- Update Wallet Settings and turn auto-recharge on.
- Set the wallet recharge amount to $100.
- Set the wallet trigger threshold to $10.

**`rsp-054` Enable SaaS subscription & set rebilling markup**

Merged SOP steps:
- Navigate to GHL Agency View, Subaccounts, then Manage Client.
- Confirm that the SaaS subscription plus Support has been turned on.
- Set account rebilling markup fees to 2.5X on phone items and 3X on other items.

**`rsp-059` Demo the live system on the Go-Live call**

Merged SOP steps:
- Demo the LeadConnector App, including contacts, calls, SMS, push notifications, and wallet usage charges.
- Demo the AI call summaries and coaching notes.
- Demo a live missed call and the AI Answering Service picking up.

</details>
